summary: All 5 changed files contain substantial formal mathematical content — definitions, lemmas, theorems, and proofs — and none qualify for hard exclusion under FILTER-004 or FILTER-007. WinAsap.lean develops auxiliary strategy machinery for Borel determinacy. IteratedRings.lean formalizes Proposition 2.24 on iterated dilatations of rings with full isomorphism and uniqueness proofs. StrictlySingular.lean defines strictly singular operators and proves basic closure properties and the compact⇒strictly-singular implication. StrictlySingularAdd.lean builds biorthogonal sequences to prove closure under addition, scalar multiplication, and negation. StrictlySingularHilbertCompact.lean proves strict singularity implies compactness on the canonical Hilbert space via finite-dimensional approximation. All files carry proper copyright headers, module docstrings, and real mathematical declarations.
